verses.rationale: Keeps complete fields and forest trees as praising subjects.
verses.before: let the field exult, and everything in it! Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
verses.after: Let the fields exult with everything in them; then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
verses.tsw_comparator: let the field exult, and everything in it! Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy

verses.rationale: Preserves doubled coming and distinct righteousness/faithfulness.
verses.before: before the LORD, for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness, and the peoples in his faithfulness.
verses.after: before the LORD, for he is coming— he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with his faithfulness.
verses.tsw_comparator: before the LORD, for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness, and the peoples in his faithfulness.

verses.rationale: Keeps worldwide shoreline/island scope.
verses.before: The LORD reigns; let the earth rejoice; let the many coastlands be glad.
verses.after: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice; let the many coastlands be glad.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD reigns; let the earth rejoice; let the many coastlands be glad.

verses.rationale: Preserves obscurity alongside ethical foundations.
verses.before: Clouds and thick darkness are all around God; righteousness and justice are the foundation of God’s throne.
verses.after: Cloud and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and justice are his throne's foundation.
verses.tsw_comparator: Clouds and thick darkness are all around God; righteousness and justice are the foundation of God’s throne.

verses.rationale: Retains destructive fire and surrounding foes.
verses.before: Fire goes before the LORD and consumes adversaries on every side.
verses.after: Fire goes before him and burns up his enemies on every side.
verses.tsw_comparator: Fire goes before the LORD and consumes adversaries on every side.

verses.rationale: Keeps the earth's personified response.
verses.before: God’s lightning lights up the world; the earth sees and trembles.
verses.after: His lightning lights the world; the earth sees it and trembles.
verses.tsw_comparator: God’s lightning lights up the world; the earth sees and trembles.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated before and distinct name/title.
verses.before: The mountains melt like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.after: Mountains melt like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: The mountains melt like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.

verses.rationale: Keeps heaven's testimony and universal human sight.
verses.before: The heavens proclaim God’s righteousness, and all the peoples see God’s glory.
verses.after: The heavens proclaim his righteousness; all the peoples see his glory.
verses.tsw_comparator: The heavens proclaim God’s righteousness, and all the peoples see God’s glory.

verses.rationale: Retains the command to gods rather than silently substituting angels.
verses.before: Everyone who serve carved images are put to shame, people who boast in worthless gods. Bow down before the LORD, all you gods.
verses.after: Let all who serve carved images be ashamed, all who boast in worthless idols. Bow before him, all you gods!
verses.tsw_comparator: All who serve carved images are put to shame, those who boast in worthless gods. Bow down before the LORD, all you gods.

verses.rationale: Keeps feminine daughters image, explained as Judah's towns.
verses.before: Zion hears and rejoices, and the daughters of Judah are glad because of your judgments, O LORD.
verses.after: Zion hears and is glad; the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments, LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: Zion hears and rejoices, and the daughters of Judah are glad because of your judgments, O LORD.

verses.rationale: Preserves both worldwide height and comparison.
verses.before: For you, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.
verses.after: For you, LORD, are Most High over all the earth, exalted far above all gods.
verses.tsw_comparator: For you, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.

verses.rationale: Keeps the pinned imperative rather than an emended divine-love statement.
verses.before: You who love the LORD, hate evil. God guards the lives of the faithful and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
verses.after: You who love the LORD, hate evil. He guards the lives of his faithful ones and rescues them from the hand of the wicked.
verses.tsw_comparator: You who love the LORD, hate evil. God guards the lives of the faithful and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

verses.rationale: Preserves sown light rather than the variant dawns.
verses.before: Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.
verses.after: Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.

verses.rationale: Retains holiness remembrance while making the idiom readable.
verses.before: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous, and give thanks to God’s holy remembrance.
verses.after: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous people, and give thanks as you remember his holiness.
verses.tsw_comparator: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous, and give thanks to God’s holy remembrance.

verses.rationale: Retains the short title and divine victory through hand/arm.
verses.before: A psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done wondrous things. His right hand and his holy arm have won salvation for him.
verses.after: A psalm. Sing a new song to the LORD, for he has worked wonders. His right hand and his holy arm have won victory for him.
verses.tsw_comparator: A psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done wondrous things. His right hand and his holy arm have won salvation for him.

verses.rationale: Keeps salvation and righteousness as public revelation.
verses.before: The LORD has revealed his salvation; before the eyes of the nations he has revealed his righteousness.
verses.after: The LORD has made his salvation known; he has revealed his righteousness before the nations' eyes.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD has made known his salvation; before the eyes of the nations he has revealed his righteousness.

verses.rationale: Retains Israel's particular covenant and worldwide witnesses.
verses.before: He has remembered his steadfast love and his faithfulness to the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.after: He has remembered his faithful love and faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.tsw_comparator: He has remembered his steadfast love and his faithfulness to the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

verses.rationale: Preserves the cascade of praise imperatives.
verses.before: Raise a shout to the LORD, all the earth; break forth, cry out for joy, and sing praise!
verses.after: Shout to the LORD, all the earth! Break into joyful song and make music.
verses.tsw_comparator: Raise a shout to the LORD, all the earth; break forth, cry out for joy, and sing praise!

verses.rationale: Keeps deliberate lyre repetition.
verses.before: Sing praise to the LORD with the lyre, with the lyre and the sound of song;
verses.after: Make music to the LORD with the lyre, with the lyre and the sound of song.
verses.tsw_comparator: Sing praise to the LORD with the lyre, with the lyre and the sound of song;

verses.rationale: Distinguishes metal trumpets and animal horn.
verses.before: with trumpets and the sound of the ram’s horn, raise a shout before the King, the LORD.
verses.after: With trumpets and the sound of the ram's horn, shout before the king, the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: with trumpets and the sound of the ram’s horn, raise a shout before the King, the LORD.

verses.rationale: Preserves both nonhuman fullness and human inhabitants.
verses.before: Let the sea roar, and all that fills it, the world and people who live in it.
verses.after: Let the sea thunder with everything in it, the world and everyone who lives in it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the sea roar, and all that fills it, the world and those who live in it.

verses.rationale: Keeps the bodily personification and shared mountain song.
verses.before: Let the rivers clap their hands; together let the mountains sing for joy
verses.after: Let the rivers clap their hands; let the mountains sing for joy together
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the rivers clap their hands; together let the mountains sing for joy

verses.rationale: Preserves the difference from Psalm 96's doubled coming and faithfulness ending.
verses.before: before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
verses.after: before the LORD, for he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples fairly.
verses.tsw_comparator: before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.

verses.rationale: Keeps both human and terrestrial trembling and cherubim throne.
verses.before: The LORD reigns; let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake.
verses.after: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth shake.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD reigns; let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake.

verses.rationale: Retains local presence and worldwide supremacy.
verses.before: The LORD is great in Zion; he is exalted over all the peoples.
verses.after: The LORD is great in Zion; he is exalted above all the peoples.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is great in Zion; he is exalted over all the peoples.

verses.rationale: Preserves the third-person holiness refrain within direct address.
verses.before: Let them praise your great and awesome name. Holy is he.
verses.after: Let them thank your great and awesome name. He is holy.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let them praise your great and awesome name. Holy is he.

verses.rationale: Renders the compressed king's-strength phrase naturally with an alternative noted.
verses.before: The strength of the king loves justice. You have established equity; you have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.after: The mighty king loves justice. You have established fairness; you have brought justice and righteousness to Jacob.
verses.tsw_comparator: The strength of the king loves justice. You have established equity; you have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.

verses.rationale: Keeps footstool worship and the repeated refrain.
verses.before: Exalt the LORD our God; bow down at his footstool. Holy is he.
verses.after: Exalt the LORD our God; bow down at his footstool. He is holy.
verses.tsw_comparator: Exalt the LORD our God; bow down at his footstool. Holy is he.

verses.rationale: Preserves Moses' inclusion among priests and Samuel's distinct grouping.
verses.before: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel also was among people who called on his name. They cried to the LORD, and he answered them.
verses.after: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel among those who called on his name. They called to the LORD, and he answered them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel also was among those who called on his name. They cried to the LORD, and he answered them.

verses.rationale: Keeps the cloud and the plural/singular law terms.
verses.before: In the pillar of cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies, and the statute that he gave them.
verses.after: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his testimonies and the statute he gave them.
verses.tsw_comparator: In the pillar of cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies, and the statute that he gave them.

verses.rationale: Preserves forgiveness and punishment together without removing their tension.
verses.before: O LORD our God, you answered them; you were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their deeds.
verses.after: LORD our God, you answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet you took vengeance for their deeds.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD our God, you answered them; you were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their deeds.

verses.rationale: Keeps the expanded final refrain and both full divine designations.
verses.before: Exalt the LORD our God, and bow down at his holy mountain; for the LORD our God is holy.
verses.after: Exalt the LORD our God; bow down at his holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
verses.tsw_comparator: Exalt the LORD our God, and bow down at his holy mountain; for the LORD our God is holy.

verses.rationale: Retains title and universal call.
verses.before: Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth!
verses.after: A psalm of thanksgiving. Shout to the LORD, all the earth!
verses.tsw_comparator: Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth!

verses.rationale: Preserves service and joyful approach.
verses.before: Serve the LORD with gladness; come before him with joyful singing.
verses.after: Serve the LORD with gladness; come before him singing for joy.
verses.tsw_comparator: Serve the LORD with gladness; come before him with joyful singing.

verses.rationale: Follows qere we are his; records written and not we ourselves in note.
verses.before: Know that the LORD, he is God! It is he who made us, and we are his; we are his people and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.after: Know that the LORD is God. He made us, and we belong to him— his people, the sheep of his pasture.
verses.tsw_comparator: Know that the LORD, he is God! It is he who made us, and we are his; we are his people and the sheep of his pasture.

verses.rationale: Retains both spatial entrances and distinct praise verbs.
verses.before: Enter his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with praise! Give thanks to him; bless his name!
verses.after: Enter his gates with thanksgiving, his courts with praise. Thank him; bless his name.
verses.tsw_comparator: Enter his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with praise! Give thanks to him; bless his name!

verses.rationale: Preserves goodness, enduring love and intergenerational faithfulness.
verses.before: For the LORD is good; his steadfast love endures forever, and his faithfulness to all generations.
verses.after: For the LORD is good; his faithful love lasts forever, and his faithfulness endures through every generation.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the LORD is good; his steadfast love endures forever, and his faithfulness to all generations.

verses.rationale: Retains the royal program's paired qualities and direct address.
verses.before: I will sing of steadfast love and justice; to you, O LORD, I will make music.
verses.after: Of David. A psalm. I will sing of faithful love and justice; to you, LORD, I will make music.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will sing of steadfast love and justice; to you, O LORD, I will make music.

verses.rationale: Preserves the abrupt question amid royal vows and the domestic setting.
verses.before: I will attend to the way of integrity. When will you come to me? I will walk with integrity of heart within my house.
verses.after: I will give careful thought to the way of integrity. When will you come to me? Within my house I will walk with an undivided heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will attend to the way of integrity. When will you come to me? I will walk with integrity of heart within my house.

verses.rationale: Keeps visual refusal and clinging metaphor without making Belial a personal name.
verses.before: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of people who fall away; it will not cling to me.
verses.after: I will set nothing worthless before my eyes. I hate the deeds of those who turn aside; they will not cling to me.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.

verses.rationale: Retains heart crookedness and knowing-evil idiom.
verses.before: A crooked heart will be far from me; I will know nothing of evil.
verses.after: A crooked heart will stay far from me; I will have nothing to do with evil.
verses.tsw_comparator: A crooked heart shall be far from me; I will know nothing of evil.

verses.rationale: Follows qere slanderer and preserves the severe royal sanction.
verses.before: Whoever secretly slanders a neighbor, I will silence; one with haughty eyes and a proud heart I will not endure.
verses.after: I will destroy anyone who secretly slanders a neighbor. I will not tolerate haughty eyes and an arrogant heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever secretly slanders a neighbor, I will silence; one with haughty eyes and a proud heart I will not endure.

verses.rationale: Keeps court selection and repeated integrity theme.
verses.before: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. Whoever walks in the way of integrity will minister to me.
verses.after: My eyes will seek the faithful in the land, so they may live with me. The one who walks with integrity will serve me.
verses.tsw_comparator: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. Whoever walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.

verses.rationale: Retains household exclusion and the speaker's own authority.
verses.before: No one who practices deceit will dwell within my house; no one who speaks lies will stand before my eyes.
verses.after: No one who practices deceit will live in my house; no liar will remain before my eyes.
verses.tsw_comparator: No one who practices deceit shall dwell within my house; no one who speaks lies shall stand before my eyes.

verses.rationale: Preserves lethal royal language, daily repetition and city scope.
verses.before: Morning by morning I will silence all the wicked of the land, cutting off from the city of the LORD everyone who do evil.
verses.after: Morning after morning I will destroy all the wicked in the land, cutting off everyone who does wrong from the LORD's city.
verses.tsw_comparator: Morning by morning I will silence all the wicked of the land, cutting off from the city of the LORD all who do evil.

verses.rationale: Preserves the whole source superscription and both divine-name occurrences.
verses.before: O LORD, hear my prayer, and let my cry come to you.
verses.after: A prayer of an afflicted person who grows faint and pours out a complaint before the LORD. LORD, hear my prayer; let my cry for help reach you.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, hear my prayer, and let my cry come to you.

verses.rationale: Keeps face, ear and urgency together.
verses.before: Do not hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Incline your ear to me; in the day I call, answer me quickly.
verses.after: Do not hide your face from me when I am in distress. Lean down and listen; answer quickly when I call.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Incline your ear to me; in the day I call, answer me quickly.

verses.rationale: Retains smoke and scorched-bone images with the rare hearth term noted.
verses.before: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like a hearth.
verses.after: My days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like embers.
verses.tsw_comparator: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like a hearth.

verses.rationale: Keeps bodily weakness and neglected food.
verses.before: My heart is struck down and withered like grass; I forget to eat my bread.
verses.after: My heart is struck down and withered like grass; I forget even to eat my bread.
verses.tsw_comparator: My heart is struck down and withered like grass; I forget to eat my bread.

verses.rationale: Retains pinned flesh rather than silently changing to skin.
verses.before: Because of the sound of my groaning, my bones cling to my flesh.
verses.after: Because of my loud groaning, my bones cling to my flesh.
verses.tsw_comparator: Because of the sound of my groaning, my bones cling to my flesh.

verses.rationale: Uses cautious bird identification and notes uncertain species.
verses.before: I am like a desert bird in the wilderness, like an owl among ruins.
verses.after: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
verses.tsw_comparator: I am like a desert bird in the wilderness, like an owl among ruins.

verses.rationale: Keeps sleeplessness and solitary rooftop setting.
verses.before: I lie awake; I am like a lonely bird on a roof.
verses.after: I lie awake, like a lone bird on a rooftop.
verses.tsw_comparator: I lie awake; I am like a lonely bird on a roof.

verses.rationale: Renders swearing by me as the contextual curse formula, noted.
verses.before: All day my enemies taunt me; people who rage against me use my name as a curse.
verses.after: All day my enemies taunt me; those who mock me use my name in curses.
verses.tsw_comparator: All day my enemies taunt me; those who rage against me use my name as a curse.

verses.rationale: Keeps ashes and tears without reducing them to generic sorrow.
verses.before: For I eat ashes like bread and mingle my drink with tears
verses.after: I eat ashes like bread and mix my drink with tears,
verses.tsw_comparator: For I eat ashes like bread and mingle my drink with tears

verses.rationale: Retains the accusation and violent lifting/casting image.
verses.before: because of your indignation and wrath; for you lifted me up and threw me down.
verses.after: because of your indignation and fury; you have lifted me up and thrown me away.
verses.tsw_comparator: because of your indignation and wrath; for you lifted me up and threw me down.

verses.rationale: Keeps declining daylight and repeated grass mortality.
verses.before: My days are like a lengthening shadow, and I wither away like grass.
verses.after: My days are like a lengthening shadow; I wither like grass.
verses.tsw_comparator: My days are like a lengthening shadow, and I wither away like grass.

verses.rationale: Retains lasting divine reign and remembered name without adding name to the divine-name count.
verses.before: But you, O LORD, are enthroned forever, and your remembrance is from generation to generation.
verses.after: But you, LORD, sit enthroned forever; your remembrance lasts through every generation.
verses.tsw_comparator: But you, O LORD, are enthroned forever, and your remembrance is from generation to generation.

verses.rationale: Keeps feminine city address and both time statements.
verses.before: You will rise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor; the appointed time has come.
verses.after: You will rise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor; the appointed time has come.
verses.tsw_comparator: You will rise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor; the appointed time has come.

verses.rationale: Preserves attachment to ruined material remains.
verses.before: For your servants delight in her stones and have compassion on her dust.
verses.after: Your servants cherish her stones and show tenderness even to her dust.
verses.tsw_comparator: For your servants delight in her stones and have compassion on her dust.

verses.rationale: Keeps third-to-second-person shift and international scope.
verses.before: The nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth your glory.
verses.after: The nations will fear the LORD's name, and all the earth's kings your glory.
verses.tsw_comparator: The nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth your glory.

verses.rationale: Reads the perfects in the anticipated restoration context without erasing their assured force.
verses.before: For the LORD will build up Zion and appear in glory.
verses.after: For the LORD will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the LORD will build up Zion and appear in glory.

verses.rationale: Keeps the destitute and repeated prayer.
verses.before: God will regard the prayer of the destitute and will not despise their prayer.
verses.after: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; he will not despise their prayer.
verses.tsw_comparator: God will regard the prayer of the destitute and will not despise their prayer.

verses.rationale: Retains written transmission, created people and short divine name.
verses.before: Let this be written for a future generation, so that a people yet to be created may praise the LORD:
verses.after: Let this be written for the generation to come, so a people yet to be created may praise YAH:
verses.tsw_comparator: Let this be written for a future generation, so that a people yet to be created may praise the LORD:

verses.rationale: Preserves doubled divine looking and spatial contrast.
verses.before: The LORD looked down from the holy height; from heaven God looked upon the earth
verses.after: he looked down from his holy height; from heaven the LORD looked at the earth,
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD looked down from the holy height; from heaven God looked upon the earth

verses.rationale: Keeps actual captives and mortal danger.
verses.before: to hear the groaning of the prisoner, to set free those appointed to death,
verses.after: to hear the prisoner's groan and release those marked for death,
verses.tsw_comparator: to hear the groaning of the prisoner, to set free those appointed to death,

verses.rationale: Retains paired place names and public proclamation.
verses.before: so that the name of the LORD may be declared in Zion and God’s praise in Jerusalem,
verses.after: so the LORD's name may be recounted in Zion and his praise in Jerusalem,
verses.tsw_comparator: so that the name of the LORD may be declared in Zion and God’s praise in Jerusalem,

verses.rationale: Keeps the larger worship assembly including kingdoms.
verses.before: when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
verses.after: when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

verses.rationale: Follows qere my strength rather than written his, with the variation recorded.
verses.before: God weakened my strength along the way and shortened my days.
verses.after: He has broken my strength along the way; he has cut my days short.
verses.tsw_comparator: God weakened my strength along the way and shortened my days.

verses.rationale: Keeps speaker's appeal and contrast between truncated life and divine years.
verses.before: I said, “My God, do not take me away at the midpoint of my days— your years endure through all generations.”
verses.after: I say, “My God, do not take me away halfway through my days, you whose years last through all generations.
verses.tsw_comparator: I said, “My God, do not take me away at the midpoint of my days— your years endure through all generations.”

verses.rationale: Preserves both creation domains and handwork image.
verses.before: Long ago you laid the foundation of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
verses.after: Long ago you founded the earth; the heavens are the work of your hands.
verses.tsw_comparator: Long ago you laid the foundation of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

verses.rationale: Retains creation's mortality and clothing-change metaphor.
verses.before: They will perish, but you will endure; all of them will wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them, and they will pass away.
verses.after: They will perish, but you will remain. They will all wear out like a garment; you will change them like clothing, and they will pass away.
verses.tsw_comparator: They will perish, but you will endure; all of them will wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them, and they will pass away.

verses.rationale: Keeps stable divine identity and endless years.
verses.before: But you are the same, and your years have no end.
verses.after: But you remain the same, and your years will never end.
verses.tsw_comparator: But you are the same, and your years have no end.

verses.rationale: Retains future generations and divine presence as the ending assurance.
verses.before: The children of your servants will dwell secure, and their descendants will be established before you.
verses.after: Your servants' children will dwell securely; their offspring will be established before you.”
verses.tsw_comparator: The children of your servants will dwell secure, and their descendants will be established before you.

verses.rationale: Renders nephesh as the whole self and preserves the doubled summons.
verses.before: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and all that is within me, bless his holy name!
verses.after: Of David. Bless the LORD, my whole being; everything within me, bless his holy name.
verses.tsw_comparator: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and all that is within me, bless his holy name!

verses.rationale: Keeps verbatim self-summons and the command to remember.
verses.before: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all his benefits,
verses.after: Bless the LORD, my whole being, and do not forget any of his benefits:
verses.tsw_comparator: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all his benefits,

verses.rationale: Retains all in both clauses and the strong healing claim.
verses.before: who forgives all your iniquity, who heals all your diseases,
verses.after: he forgives all your wrongdoing and heals all your diseases;
verses.tsw_comparator: who forgives all your iniquity, who heals all your diseases,

verses.rationale: Keeps redemption and coronation images together.
verses.before: who redeems your life from the pit, who crowns you with steadfast love and compassion,
verses.after: he redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with faithful love and compassion;
verses.tsw_comparator: who redeems your life from the pit, who crowns you with steadfast love and compassion,

verses.rationale: Chooses life for difficult edyekh and flags alternatives; retains eagle comparison.
verses.before: who satisfies you with good so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
verses.after: he satisfies your life with good things, so your youth is renewed like an eagle's.
verses.tsw_comparator: who satisfies you with good so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

verses.rationale: Preserves plural righteous deeds and all oppressed people.
verses.before: The LORD works righteousness and justice for everyone who are oppressed.
verses.after: The LORD works acts of righteousness and brings justice to all who are oppressed.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD works righteousness and justice for all who are oppressed.

verses.rationale: Keeps personal Moses and national audience distinct.
verses.before: He revealed his ways to Moses, his acts to the children of Israel.
verses.after: He made his ways known to Moses, his deeds to the people of Israel.
verses.tsw_comparator: He made known his ways to Moses, his acts to the children of Israel.

verses.rationale: Retains the familiar divine-mercy formula consistently with Psalm 86.
verses.before: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.
verses.after: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger and rich in faithful love.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.

verses.rationale: Keeps judicial contention and lasting-anger denial.
verses.before: He will not always accuse, nor will he keep his anger forever.
verses.after: He will not always bring charges or hold on to anger forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: He will not always accuse, nor will he keep his anger forever.

verses.rationale: Preserves communal confession and unearned restraint.
verses.before: He does not deal with us according to our sins, nor repay us according to our iniquities.
verses.after: He has not treated us as our sins deserve or repaid us according to our wrongs.
verses.tsw_comparator: He does not deal with us according to our sins, nor repay us according to our iniquities.

verses.rationale: Keeps height comparison and the fear qualification.
verses.before: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his steadfast love toward people who fear him;
verses.after: As high as the heavens stand above the earth, so mighty is his faithful love toward those who fear him.
verses.tsw_comparator: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his steadfast love toward those who fear him;

verses.rationale: Retains immeasurable directional separation and rebellion language.
verses.before: as far as the east is from the west, so far he removes our transgressions from us.
verses.after: As far as east is from west, so far has he removed our rebellions from us.
verses.tsw_comparator: as far as the east is from the west, so far he removes our transgressions from us.

verses.rationale: Preserves gender-specific father image and repeated compassion.
verses.before: As a father shows compassion to his children, so the LORD shows compassion to people who fear him.
verses.after: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
verses.tsw_comparator: As a father shows compassion to his children, so the LORD shows compassion to those who fear him.

verses.rationale: Keeps formed human material and divine remembrance.
verses.before: For he knows our frame; he remembers that we are dust.
verses.after: For he knows how we are formed; he remembers that we are dust.
verses.tsw_comparator: For he knows our frame; he remembers that we are dust.

verses.rationale: Retains humanity's floral transience with natural inclusive English.
verses.before: As for humanity—his days are like grass; he flourishes like a flower of the field;
verses.after: Human days are like grass; we bloom like a flower in the field.
verses.tsw_comparator: As for humanity—his days are like grass; he flourishes like a flower of the field;

verses.rationale: Keeps the flower's disappearance and personified place.
verses.before: for the wind passes over it, and it is gone, and its place knows it no more.
verses.after: A wind passes over it, and it is gone; its place knows it no more.
verses.tsw_comparator: for the wind passes over it, and it is gone, and its place knows it no more.

verses.rationale: Preserves duration, fear and multigenerational righteousness.
verses.before: But the steadfast love of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting on people who fear him, and his righteousness to children’s children,
verses.after: But the LORD's faithful love is from eternity to eternity toward those who fear him, and his righteousness reaches their children's children,
verses.tsw_comparator: But the steadfast love of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear him, and his righteousness to children’s children,

verses.rationale: Keeps obedience as enacted memory, not mere recollection.
verses.before: to people who keep his covenant and remember to do his commandments.
verses.after: those who keep his covenant and remember his instructions by doing them.
verses.tsw_comparator: to those who keep his covenant and remember to do his commandments.

verses.rationale: Retains cosmic throne and comprehensive rule.
verses.before: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens, and his kingdom rules over all.
verses.after: The LORD has established his throne in heaven; his kingdom rules over everything.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens, and his kingdom rules over all.

verses.rationale: Keeps angelic strength, obedience and repeated word.
verses.before: Bless the LORD, O you his angels, you mighty ones who do his word, obeying the voice of his word!
verses.after: Bless the LORD, you his angels, mighty in strength, who carry out his word and listen to the voice of his word.
verses.tsw_comparator: Bless the LORD, O you his angels, you mighty ones who do his word, obeying the voice of his word!

verses.rationale: Preserves heavenly armies alongside ministers.
verses.before: Bless the LORD, all his hosts, his ministers, who do his will!
verses.after: Bless the LORD, all his armies, his ministers who do his will.
verses.tsw_comparator: Bless the LORD, all his hosts, his ministers, who do his will!

verses.rationale: Retains universal expansion and exact return to the opening summons.
verses.before: Bless the LORD, all his works, in all places of his dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
verses.after: Bless the LORD, all his works, in every place where he rules. Bless the LORD, my whole being.
verses.tsw_comparator: Bless the LORD, all his works, in all places of his dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!

verses.rationale: Keeps link with Psalm 103 and both divine-name occurrences.
verses.before: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty,
verses.after: Bless the LORD, my whole being. LORD my God, you are very great, clothed in splendor and majesty.
verses.tsw_comparator: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty,

verses.rationale: Preserves luminous clothing and stretched fabric heavens.
verses.before: covering yourself with light as with a garment, stretching out the heavens like a tent,
verses.after: You wrap yourself in light like a garment and stretch out the heavens like a tent curtain.
verses.tsw_comparator: covering yourself with light as with a garment, stretching out the heavens like a tent,

verses.rationale: Keeps the source's shift to he and ancient cosmic architecture.
verses.before: laying the beams of his chambers on the waters, making the clouds his chariot, riding on the wings of the wind,
verses.after: He lays the beams of his upper rooms in the waters; he makes clouds his chariot and rides on the wings of the wind.
verses.tsw_comparator: laying the beams of his chambers on the waters, making the clouds his chariot, riding on the wings of the wind,

verses.rationale: Chooses the weather-as-servants reading while noting the reversible Hebrew construction.
verses.before: making his messengers winds, his ministers a flaming fire.
verses.after: He makes winds his messengers, flaming fire his ministers.
verses.tsw_comparator: making his messengers winds, his ministers a flaming fire.

verses.rationale: Preserves ancient stability imagery rather than modernizing cosmology.
verses.before: He set the earth on its foundations, so that it should never be moved.
verses.after: He founded the earth on its supports, so it will never be shaken.
verses.tsw_comparator: He set the earth on its foundations, so that it should never be moved.

verses.rationale: Keeps the watery garment and submerged mountains.
verses.before: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.after: You covered it with the deep like a garment; waters stood above the mountains.
verses.tsw_comparator: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.rationale: Retains waters' personified flight and paired divine sounds.
verses.before: At your rebuke they fled; at the sound of your thunder they hurried away—
verses.after: At your rebuke they fled; at the sound of your thunder they hurried away.
verses.tsw_comparator: At your rebuke they fled; at the sound of your thunder they hurried away—

verses.rationale: Chooses landforms as subjects and records waters-traversing alternative.
verses.before: the mountains rose, the valleys sank down to the place that you appointed for them.
verses.after: Mountains rose and valleys sank to the place you had established for them.
verses.tsw_comparator: the mountains rose, the valleys sank down to the place that you appointed for them.

verses.rationale: Keeps waters' fixed limit and no-return promise.
verses.before: You set a boundary that they may not pass, so that they might not again cover the earth.
verses.after: You set a boundary they cannot cross; they will never return to cover the earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: You set a boundary that they may not pass, so that they might not again cover the earth.

verses.rationale: Retains divine provision through particular terrain.
verses.before: You send forth springs into the valleys; they flow between the mountains;
verses.after: He sends springs into the ravines; they flow between the mountains.
verses.tsw_comparator: You send forth springs into the valleys; they flow between the mountains;

verses.rationale: Keeps all wild animals and the named example.
verses.before: they give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.after: They give drink to every beast of the field; wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.tsw_comparator: they give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

verses.rationale: Preserves habitat and bird voices.
verses.before: Beside them the birds of the heavens dwell; they sing among the branches.
verses.after: Beside them the birds of the sky make their homes; from among the branches they sing.
verses.tsw_comparator: Beside them the birds of the heavens dwell; they sing among the branches.

verses.rationale: Keeps the change from his to your and the earth's satisfaction.
verses.before: From your upper chambers you water the mountains; the earth is satisfied with the fruit of your work.
verses.after: He waters the mountains from his upper rooms; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of your work.
verses.tsw_comparator: From your upper chambers you water the mountains; the earth is satisfied with the fruit of your work.

verses.rationale: Retains animals and human agricultural labor as distinct provisions.
verses.before: You cause the grass to grow for the cattle, and plants for the service of humankind, that he may bring forth food from the earth,
verses.after: He makes grass grow for livestock and plants for people to cultivate, bringing food out of the earth:
verses.tsw_comparator: You cause the grass to grow for the cattle, and plants for the service of humankind, that he may bring forth food from the earth,

verses.rationale: Keeps wine without substitution, cosmetic oil and repeated heart.
verses.before: and wine to gladden the heart of man, oil to make his face shine, and bread to strengthen man’s heart.
verses.after: wine that gladdens the human heart, oil that makes the face shine, and bread that strengthens the human heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: and wine to gladden the heart of man, oil to make his face shine, and bread to strengthen man’s heart.

verses.rationale: Retains tree satisfaction and named cedars.
verses.before: The trees of the LORD are watered abundantly, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.
verses.after: The LORD's trees drink their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.
verses.tsw_comparator: The trees of the LORD are watered abundantly, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.

verses.rationale: Keeps stork and separate tree kind, with species uncertainty noted.
verses.before: In them the birds build their nests; the stork has her home in the fir trees.
verses.after: Birds make their nests there; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
verses.tsw_comparator: In them the birds build their nests; the stork has her home in the fir trees.

verses.rationale: Retains nonhuman habitats and avoids rabbit mistranslation.
verses.before: The high mountains are for the wild goats; the rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
verses.after: The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the rocks provide refuge for the hyraxes.
verses.tsw_comparator: The high mountains are for the wild goats; the rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

verses.rationale: Keeps calendrical moon and knowing sun personification.
verses.before: He made the moon for appointed times; the sun knows its going down.
verses.after: He made the moon to mark appointed times; the sun knows when to set.
verses.tsw_comparator: He made the moon for appointed times; the sun knows its going down.

verses.rationale: Preserves the direct address and animals' nighttime activity.
verses.before: You make darkness, and it is night, when all the beasts of the forest creep out.
verses.after: You bring darkness, and night comes; all the forest animals move about in it.
verses.tsw_comparator: You make darkness, and it is night, when all the beasts of the forest creep out.

verses.rationale: Keeps predation within creation's dependence on God.
verses.before: The young lions roar for their prey, seeking their food from God.
verses.after: Young lions roar for prey, seeking their food from God.
verses.tsw_comparator: The young lions roar for their prey, seeking their food from God.

verses.rationale: Retains daily retreat without moralizing animal behavior.
verses.before: When the sun rises, they withdraw and lie down in their dens.
verses.after: When the sun rises, they withdraw and lie down in their dens.
verses.tsw_comparator: When the sun rises, they withdraw and lie down in their dens.

verses.rationale: Keeps human day labor paired with animal night activity.
verses.before: Man goes out to his work and to his labor until the evening.
verses.after: People go out to their work, to their labor until evening.
verses.tsw_comparator: Man goes out to his work and to his labor until the evening.

verses.rationale: Retains multiplicity and wisdom rather than ranking creatures by human usefulness.
verses.before: O LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom you have made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verses.after: How many are your works, LORD! You made them all with wisdom; the earth is full of your creatures.
verses.tsw_comparator: O LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom you have made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.

verses.rationale: Preserves uncountable sea life and scale contrast.
verses.before: There is the sea, great and wide, teeming with creatures without number, living things both small and great.
verses.after: There is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond counting, living things both small and great.
verses.tsw_comparator: There is the sea, great and wide, teeming with creatures without number, living things both small and great.

verses.rationale: Keeps Leviathan as playful creature; notes possible divine play-with-him reading.
verses.before: There go the ships, and Leviathan, which you formed to play in it.
verses.after: Ships travel there, and Leviathan, whom you formed to play in it.
verses.tsw_comparator: There go the ships, and Leviathan, which you formed to play in it.

verses.rationale: Retains universal dependence and timely feeding.
verses.before: These all look to you, to give them their food in due season.
verses.after: All of them wait for you to give them food at the right time.
verses.tsw_comparator: These all look to you, to give them their food in due season.

verses.rationale: Keeps provision, creature gathering and open hand.
verses.before: When you give to them, they gather it; when you open your hand, they are filled with good things.
verses.after: You give to them, and they gather it; you open your hand, and they are filled with good things.
verses.tsw_comparator: When you give to them, they gather it; when you open your hand, they are filled with good things.

verses.rationale: Retains divine withdrawal, real death and return to dust.
verses.before: When you hide your face, they are dismayed; when you take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.
verses.after: You hide your face, and they are terrified; you take away their breath, and they die and return to their dust.
verses.tsw_comparator: When you hide your face, they are dismayed; when you take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.

verses.rationale: Keeps breath continuity with verse 29 and notes spirit range.
verses.before: When you send forth your Spirit, they are created, and you renew the face of the ground.
verses.after: You send your breath, and they are created; you renew the face of the ground.
verses.tsw_comparator: When you send forth your Spirit, they are created, and you renew the face of the ground.

verses.rationale: Preserves the repeated divine name and desire for divine joy.
verses.before: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in his works,
verses.after: May the LORD's glory last forever; may the LORD rejoice in his works—
verses.tsw_comparator: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in his works,

verses.rationale: Keeps the awe-inspiring power within creation praise.
verses.before: who looks on the earth and it trembles, who touches the mountains and they smoke.
verses.after: he looks at the earth, and it trembles; he touches the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.tsw_comparator: who looks on the earth and it trembles, who touches the mountains and they smoke.

verses.rationale: Retains both lifelong commitments.
verses.before: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have being.
verses.after: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will make music to my God while I have being.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have being.

verses.rationale: Keeps pleasing reflection and the poet's own joy.
verses.before: May my meditation be pleasing to him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
verses.after: May my meditation be pleasing to him; I will rejoice in the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: May my meditation be pleasing to him, for I rejoice in the LORD.

verses.rationale: Preserves the severe final wish and both full/short divine names rather than softening sinners to sins.
verses.before: Let sinners be consumed from the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Praise the LORD.
verses.after: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my whole being. Praise YAH!
verses.tsw_comparator: Let sinners be consumed from the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Praise the LORD.

comparative_references.scope: All 746 TSW verses read after independent drafting from each selected Hebrew record and all annotations. Shared wording is retained where clear; overlap is triage only.
